What happens next

  1. We call you

    One of our team rings you during practice hours to talk through what you would like to change about your smile, answer your questions and find a consultation time that suits you.

  2. Your smile consultation

    A £50 non-refundable deposit secures the appointment. It includes your complimentary oral examination and X-rays, a full smile assessment and an honest answer on whether bonding and whitening suit your goals.

  3. Your written plan

    You leave with a clear, written breakdown of your options and costs — including how many teeth bonding would involve, and how 0% finance over 12 months would work for you.

Would you rather not wait?

We're open Monday to Friday. Ring the practice and we'll talk it through now — no obligation.

Worth thinking about before we speak

None of this is homework — it just means we can give you a straighter answer on the call.

  • Which teeth bother you most Chips, gaps, uneven edges, shade — or the one tooth you always notice in photographs.
  • A photo of a smile you like It is far easier to design towards something you can point at than something you are describing.
  • Whether there is a date in mind A wedding, a holiday or a photograph coming up changes the sequence we suggest — whitening has to come before bonding.
  • Anything you're nervous about Say it on the call. It is the single most useful thing you can tell us.
